tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard
tests.summary:
Completed the requested registration using the name Kane Tester, email kanew42ppy@mlyfo.app, and username kanew42ppy.
Confirmed that the username @kanew42ppy was available before creating the account.
Created the account with the provided password.
The account opened successfully with the heading “Welcome, Kane” and a wallet balance of $500.00.

tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard
tests.summary:
You asked to create an account for Kane Tester using the provided email address and username.
Entered the full name, email address, and username; the username was confirmed as available.
Entered the password and created the account.
The account was created successfully, showing “Welcome, Kane” with a wallet balance of $500.00.

tests.name: Split a $236 bill four ways and get a link per person
tests.summary:
Created the requested split for “Kane dinner w42p91” with a total of $236, shared with zoya, kabir, and sofia.
The form calculated four people at $59.00 each.
The new split is listed as “1 of 4 paid,” with $59.00 and a Copy link button available for zoya, kabir, and sofia.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
Opened the sign-in flow, then navigated to the Shield address-checking page.
Entered the provided wallet address and selected “Check address.”
The address was marked “Blocked,” with a warning that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.
The check was completed on the Shield page.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and check the supplied wallet address on the Shield page.
The address was entered into the address-check field and submitted.
The check marked the address as “Blocked” and warned: “This looks like Ada’s saved address but isn’t.”

tests.name: A payment over the spend limit waits for password confirmation
tests.summary:
You asked to send $150.00 to @ada for rent using the message “pay @ada 150 for rent.”
The payment was initiated, and the confirmation screen showed “Confirm $150.00 to @ada” along with the per-payment limit notice.
The password was entered and the payment was confirmed.
The payment completed successfully, with the page showing “Sent $150.00 to @ada.”

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
You asked to check the link https://phantorn-airdrop.app/claim using the site’s Quick check feature.
Entered the link and ran the check.
The result marked the link as Dangerous and stated that the address imitates Phantom but is not the real site.

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
You asked to check the safety of https://phantorn-airdrop.app/claim.
Entered the link and selected Quick check.
The result marked the link as Dangerous and explained that the address imitates Phantom rather than being the real site.

tests.name: Shield refuses to save a look-alike of a saved person
tests.summary:
Attempted to add a person named “Ada new” with the provided wallet address on the People page.
Saved the person details.
The page reported that the address was not saved because it appears to be Ada’s saved address.
“Ada new” was not added to the people list.

tests.name: Paying a name that is both a saved person and another user asks who you meant
tests.summary:
Requested a $5 payment for coffee to Semi.
Entered “pay semi 5 for coffee” and selected the $5.00 payment option.
When asked to choose between matching recipients, selected “Your contact Semi.”
The payment was completed, with the page confirming “Sent $5.00 to Semi.”

tests.name: A payment gives a receipt with an ID and a public receipt page
tests.summary:
Opened the Receipt link from Recent activity as requested.
The receipt page confirmed a $10.00 payment to @kabir.
The receipt ID was shown as MLY-QQ42-KQLY.

tests.name: A payment gives a receipt with an ID and a public receipt page
tests.summary:
You asked to open the Receipt link from Recent activity.
The Receipt link was selected.
The receipt page displayed a $10.00 payment to @kabir with receipt ID MLY-GQTT-KET5.

tests.name: The Android keyboard hands a copied address to Shield
tests.summary:
The requested sign-in step was completed, then the address-check page was opened for AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx.
The Shield page displayed the supplied address in the address field.
The check marked the address as Blocked and warned that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not the saved address.

tests.name: The Android keyboard hands a copied address to Shield
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and open the Shield check for the provided address.
The Shield page opened with AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx filled into the address field.
The check completed and marked the address as “Blocked,” with a warning that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved Ethereum and Base address
tests.summary:
The supplied address has only 39 characters after “0x”, while Ethereum and Base addresses require 40. The application therefore showed an invalid-address block message, so the expected saved-address look-alike result could not appear.
Correct the test fixture to a complete 40-character Ethereum/Base address that is configured as Ada (Base)’s look-alike, then rerun the assertions.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved Ethereum and Base address
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and check the address 0x7a3f9cE5b801Dd3fA7426C9e0B1f8a5d3e27c4b9 in Shield.
The Shield page was opened, the address was entered, and the address check was run.
The result marked the address as Blocked, labelled it as both an Ethereum and Base address, and warned that it looks like Ada (Base)’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: The Android page offers the app install and a safe keyboard download
tests.summary:
Opened the Mlyfo web manifest page as requested.
Confirmed the page provides the Android keyboard download option, Chrome installation guidance, and the stated privacy and permission information.
Confirmed the download-check section includes a SHA-256 fingerprint.
Confirmed the manifest lists the app name as “Mlyfo” with display mode “standalone”.

tests.name: The Android page offers the app install and a safe keyboard download
tests.summary:
Opened the requested Mlyfo manifest page.
Confirmed that the displayed manifest lists the app name as “Mlyfo” and its display mode as “standalone”.
The requested page loaded successfully at the specified address.
